addressed.instructions: Read `item.text` for this directive from `anchor.statement`: a rebase-required outcome leaves metadata.sanity_round unchanged and does not count toward max_sanity_rounds. Answer yes only when the item itself states that content. Answer no when the item is silent, mentions the subject without that content, or plans a different approach (for example it counts rebase-required as a round). Do not judge conflict.

criteria.no: The item plans none of the numbered cases; it may be silent about the directive.

contradicted.instructions: `anchor.statement` says a rebase-required outcome leaves metadata.sanity_round unchanged and does not count toward max_sanity_rounds. Does `item.text` plan any of these: (1) incrementing metadata.sanity_round on a rebase-required outcome; (2) counting rebase-required outcomes toward max_sanity_rounds, or escalating because of them? Silence is never a conflict. Also not a conflict: incrementing sanity_round on a sanity FAIL; silence about the counter; sending rebase-required to the dev. Judge conflict only.
